children: Eramet launched a share capital increase targeting approximately €500M gross, with 34,506,054 new shares priced at €14.49 each. Proceeds will reduce indebtedness; APE committed approximately €322M, or 64% of the issue.
The issuance raises equity while the stated use of proceeds is debt reduction, diluting existing holders who do not participate.
The new shares expand the share count; the subscription price is materially below the cited €38.48 closing price on 11 November.
The commitment covers most of the issue, but the release gives no subscription intentions for other shareholders.
Proceeds intended to reduce Group indebtedness
Debt reduction and covenant compliance are the stated balance-sheet objectives; the release gives no expected post-issue debt figure.
Subscription ratio: 5 rights for 6 new shares
Eligible holders can maintain or increase their position by subscribing; unexercised rights become void after the subscription period.

This is a financing action under Eramet’s previously announced plan to improve cash generation and strengthen its balance sheet. Completion of the subscription period and disclosure of final proceeds, participation and post-issue leverage would show the scale of the balance-sheet effect.
